Keybind.ToggleHint: Show or hide XCOM-style movement destinations for the selected token.

Notify.NoSpeed: The selected token has no speed for the selected movement mode.
Notify.UnsupportedGrid: Easy Grid Movement currently supports square-grid scenes only.
Notify.PathBlocked: That movement path is no longer available.
Notify.MoveFailed: The token could not be moved to that destination.
Notify.NoDashAction: No action is available for Dash. Restore the required action on the combat bar if another feature grants one.
Notify.DashRefundFailed: Movement failed, but the Dash action could not be restored. Check the combat bar before trying again.

Dash.Title: Use Dash?
Dash.ActionPrompt: This route exceeds your remaining movement. Use your action to Dash and move along this route?
Dash.BonusPrompt: This route exceeds your remaining movement. Use your bonus action to Dash and move along this route?
Dash.OverRange: This route also exceeds the movement granted by one Dash. Continuing requires another source of movement; only one Dash will be spent here.

Settings.ConfirmDashHint: Ask before committing movement beyond your remaining green range. This is your personal setting and applies immediately. Turning it off skips the dialog; Dash still spends the appropriate action when BG3 Combat Bar is active.
Settings.DebugHint: Write detailed diagnostic information to the browser console.

EGM.Settings.DetectThreatsHint: Show visible enemies with ranged weapons that can reach your destination. Pause movement when a new threat comes into sight. Changes apply immediately for you.
EGM.Threats.Continue: Click to continue. Right-click to stop.
